fusions.name: Out of the Reeds
fusions.desc: Springs up to 6 tiles onto the target and stabs down, dealing 14 damage and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Splashdown
fusions.desc: Slaps the shaft flat on the ground, dealing 3 water damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 40% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Shed the Slime
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 conditions from you and restores 12 health.

fusions.name: Spring Reset
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you regain 10 stamina. Once every 6 seconds.
